Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.messenger

Class AccountConfig

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.messenger.AccountConfig
public class AccountConfig extends Object
A saved connection/account: everything needed to reach one chat network over one MessengerProtocol. Persisted as JSON by MessengerStore.

Security: the password fields are JsonIgnore and therefore never written to disk. A secret lives only in memory for the lifetime of the session and is entered (or re-entered) at connect time; the persistent record keeps just a passwordPrompt flag so the UI knows to ask.

    • getPeerFingerprint

      public String getPeerFingerprint()
      The pinned identity fingerprint of a P2P peer (nullable, and unlike the passwords it is persisted, since a fingerprint is public). It is recorded on first contact (TOFU) and used to display and verify the peer's identity later; a change raises a man-in-the-middle warning.
